newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Shiva, Ascend off. [Corrected 15:50 gmt]
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Shiva, Ascend off. [Corrected 15:50 gmt]

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc's $3.7 billion agreement to acquire Cascade Communications Corp depressed Ascend shares before Monday's market open while setting off an early rally in Cascade, traders said.
Ahead of the opening bell, Ascend declined to 46-1/2 from 52 in vigorous third market trade, while Cascade climbed to 31-3/8 from 28-3/4. Cascade reached 32-3/4 at one point in the morning.
Late Sunday night Ascend said it had agreed to acquire Cascade by exchanging 0.7 Ascend shares for each Cascade share. (Corrects exchange ratio)
Cascade also warned last night that it expects first quarter earnings of between $0.14 to $0.15 per share, below the Wall Street consensus estimate of $0.22 as compiled by First Call.
Shiva Corp shares were abandoned by investors early Monday after the company said first quarter earings and revenues would be below analysts' expectations.
In pre-open trade, Shiva fell to eight from 11-7/8, traders said.
Shiva also announced the resignation of its chief financial officer.

Other shares active before Monday's market open included Cisco Systems, off two to 49; Apple Computer trading in line at 18-5/8; Intel, also trading in line at 139-1/8, and Applied Material Inc, down to 47-1/2 from 48-1/4.
